### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the one thing asked" (state a settlement figure / hand over payment straight away): excluded by the settlement prerequisite sentence and the absence of a non-redemption payoff quote; quoting the deficiency straight away is excluded by the deficiency prerequisite and the absence of a transport charge dated on or after 2026-06-28.
- Closest alternatives: transport dated today rather than 2026-06-30 — excluded by "dated the lot-intake date"; transport at $135 — excluded by tow-rate replacement table; post-sale run to the good-through date (88 days) — excluded by post_sale_interest_end "sold at least 60 days … runs for the 60 days … only"; post-sale at full rate — excluded by lease table; settlement on the whole quote — excluded by settlement_base_recovery_history row 1; 55% — excluded by sale-age 80% replacement.
- Openness noted (not a defect): interaction of the 60-day post-sale window with the 6 interest-free days is resolved by day-set reading ("ending on the 60th day after the sale date"; interest-free days are "the days after the sale date up to and including the notice mailing date", which lie inside that window) → 54; a count-first reading (88 − 6 = 82, then cap 60) would give 60 and 19.80, deficiency 3350.99. The day-set reading is what the visible wording entails; recorded for comparison.
